summary: Adds a standalone self-host Docker Compose file and environment example that run the published Oracle backend image with a local Oracle XE database.
userImpact: Self-hosters can download docker-compose.selfhost-oracle.yml and selfhost-oracle.env.example and start EnterpriseGlue on Oracle without cloning the repository.
configuration: IMAGE_TAG defaults to the v0.32.0 release because the Oracle backend repository publishes stable release tags only.
ORACLE_DB_IMAGE selects the local Oracle XE container; ORACLE_ADMIN_PASSWORD optionally separates the SYS password from ORACLE_PASSWORD.

notes: This change does not alter database schemas or data.

security: The database and backend stay on the project-scoped network without published host ports; only the frontend port is published.
documentation: The Docker getting-started guide and Compose layout README describe the Oracle self-host path.
knownLimitations: The Oracle backend image is published to GHCR only; the frontend Docker Hub alternative remains available.
rollback: Remove the Oracle self-host Compose file; existing deployments are unaffected.
validation: CI renders the standalone Oracle self-host Compose file from a temporary directory and asserts project-scoped networking.
